quests.title: The Ripsaw Band
quests.summary: A hurricane party has left the ripsaw band with no instruments. Find a saw, a goatskin drum and a gourd shaker, then silence a heckler.

steps.text: Get a carpenter's saw from the Salt Raker at the Salt Works.
Get the goatskin drum from the Old Fisher by the boats.
Get the gourd shaker from the volunteer at the museum.
Beat Heckler Sands outside the Ripsaw Bar, then tell the Band Manager.

quests.reward: A Conch Shell Horn (a charm: tide moves hurt less).
